t: Kurt S. Adler - Wikipedia
s: September 20, 2025 - Kurt Stephan Adler (June 19, 1921 – November 25, 2004) was a German-American businessman. He was the founder of Kurt S. Adler, Inc., one of the world's largest Christmas ornament businesses. Adler was born into a Jewish family on June 19, 1921, in Würzburg, Germany.
